title: Taking Tokenization off the Host for Agentic LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2610.13325v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted. Tokenization, a CPU stage long treated as negligible, becomes the largest part of time-to-first-token (TTFT), and a frontend that tokenizes for a whole GPU fleet limits how many GPUs it can feed. We present GraphTok, a GPU tokenizer that runs the entire encoding pipeline, from pre-tokenization through byte-pair encoding (BPE) merging to token-ID assembly, as one replayable CUDA graph. GraphTok reproduces the reference token IDs bit-for-bit on GPT-2, Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemma 3, hands short inputs to a CPU engine where the GPU cannot win, and plugs into unmodified vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo. GraphTok encodes one million GPT-2 tokens in 1.7-3.2 ms including data transfers, and on Llama 3 it is 4.7-6.0x faster than giga

translated_title: 面向智能体化 LLM 服务的分词任务主机卸载方案
translated_abstract: 智能体工作负载会在多次调用间重复发送几乎不变的长上下文。前缀缓存如今已能跳过大部分预填充阶段，但在查询缓存之前，每个请求仍必须完整地进行分词。分词这一长期以来被视为可忽略不计的 CPU 阶段，如今已成为首 token 时间（TTFT）中占比最大的部分，而为一个 GPU 集群进行分词的前端也限制了其所能支撑的 GPU 数量。我们提出了 GraphTok，一个 GPU 分词器，它将整个编码流水线——从预分词、字节对编码（BPE）合并到 token ID 组装——作为一个可重放的 CUDA 图来运行。GraphTok 在 GPT-2、Llama 3、Qwen 2.5、DeepSeek-V3 和 Gemma 3 上逐位复现了参考 token ID，在 GPU 无法占优的短输入场景下将其交给 CPU 引擎处理，并可无缝接入未经修改的 vLLM 和 NVIDIA Dynamo。GraphTok 在包含数据传输的情况下，仅用 1.7-3.2 毫秒即可编码一百万个 GPT-2 token，在 Llama 3 上比 giga（原文截断）快 4.7-6.0 倍。
tldr: 提出 GraphTok，一个将完整分词流水线封装为可重放 CUDA 图并逐位复现参考结果的 GPU 分词器，比 CPU 快 4.7-6.0 倍，可将分词从主机彻底卸载，从而显著降低智能体场景下 LLM 服务的首 token 延迟并提升 GPU 集群可扩展性。
en_tdlr: GraphTok is a GPU tokenizer that wraps the entire encoding pipeline into a single replayable CUDA graph, reproducing reference token IDs bit-for-bit and running 4.7-6.0x faster than CPU, thereby offloading tokenization from the host to slash TTFT and scale GPU fleets for agentic LLM serving.
